answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 66652 Country: India Title: Is it allowed to batch without any cloth in closed bathroom? Question: Is it allowed to batch without any cloth in closed bathroom? Is wudhu valid without cloth in closed bathroom during ghusl? Answer ID: 66652 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 811/692/D=11/1437) One can take a bath naked in closed bathroom, it is lawful, but it is better to take bath wearing lungi etc. The wudhu which is done while taking a bath naked shall be valid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
